summary: My Library writes, a third follow-up: the owner checks of the write path read a layout-effect mirror, so they move in a profile switch's own commit with the other two refs (an answer landing between the commit and its passive effects could still say a refusal under the new profile, or send the queue's closing read after a sign-out); the closing read's owner checks and the reverse case (a Parent's save out across a switch while the Kid's stored copy holds that title) are pinned. Independent reviewer, by reading: lows-only; the one low is that the closing read's two owner checks are pinned only together (a test-only change is with the builder). The phase of the owner refs has no deterministic test, which CLAUDE.md states.
